title: 摩根士丹利Jim Caron：债券收益率吸引力上升，但信用利差暗藏风险
speaker: Jim Caron

segments.en: Yeah. So when we look at the level of yields right now in bonds, I mean, yes, I know 5% is a number that a lot of people haven't seen in a very, very long time and yields have come up
segments.zh: 是的。当我们看现在债券的收益率水平，我知道5%是很多人很久没见过的数字，收益率已经上升

segments.en: and they've come back down. But I also look at credit spreads.
segments.zh: 然后又回落了。但我也看信用利差。

segments.en: So my worry about the bond markets isn't so much about the interest rate level.
segments.zh: 所以我对债券市场的担忧并不在于利率水平。

segments.en: The interest rate level looks interesting at this point.
segments.zh: 目前利率水平看起来有意思。

segments.en: But investment grade credit spreads are still very tight. And if there is a risk event in the markets, those spreads can widen and that could be problematic.
segments.zh: 但**级信用利差仍然很窄。如果市场出现风险事件，利差可能扩大，那可能有问题。

segments.en: High yield spreads have already started to widen.
segments.zh: 高收益利差已经开始扩大。

segments.en: But by historical standards, they're still very tight right now.
segments.zh: 但按历史标准，它们现在仍然很窄。

segments.en: So when I think about the bond market, I mean, yes, could we buy US treasuries if there's a risk off event and could this be an interesting opportunity, 5%, not a bad level?
segments.zh: 所以当我考虑债券市场时，是的，如果出现避险事件，我们能否购买美国国债，这是否是一个有趣的机会，5%的水平不错？

segments.en: I'm more worried about the credit markets right now. So I don't think that it's just an easy, just buy bonds and don't worry about it because I think that there are segments of the bond markets that still are very expensive.
segments.zh: 我现在更担心信用市场。所以我不认为只是简单买入债券然后高枕无忧，因为我认为债券市场有些部分仍然非常昂贵。
